summary: Built the 'My open enquiries' Lead list view (filterScope Mine, LEAD.CONVERTED equals 0, columns Name, Company, Lead Source, Lead Source Detail, Lead Status, Created Date, shared only to group Persona_Recruitment_Officer). Granted read-only FLS on Lead.LeadSource in Persona_Recruitment_Officer so the Lead Source column renders for the persona. All Apex (RunLocalTests) and Playwright tests pass in the agent scratch org.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest.shouldShowListViewToRecruitmentOfficer; Playwright '#20 AC1: Leads tab offers the "My open enquiries" list view'
Playwright '#20 AC2: shows only my unconverted Leads with the agreed columns'
MyOpenEnquiriesListViewDenialTest.shouldHideListViewFromPersonaOutsideGroup; Playwright '#20 AC3: list view is shared only with the persona public group'

notes: Test change 1 (TST-11): the denial method moved unchanged from MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest into MyOpenEnquiriesListViewDenialTest. Once a user without Lead access queries ListView for Lead, every later ListView query in the same test class returns no Lead list views, even for admin. The positive test then depended on run order. Separate classes are not affected. Assertions unchanged.

Test change 2: the Playwright seed no longer sets Lead_Source_Detail__c. The CLI (admin) user has no FLS on it and anonymous Apex enforces FLS, both at compile time and on dynamic put(). The value was never asserted.
Test change 3: the AC2 header filter also excludes 'Row Number', the label Lightning gives the row-number column. Data-column assertion unchanged.

Harness observations for a person (not changed here): scripts/personas.mjs appends to tests/e2e/.auth/persona.env, and global-setup takes the first (stale) line on a rerun; frontdoor URLs expire if Playwright does not run soon after personas.mjs.
Locally, sf source tracking held a stale path, so the final deploys used sf project convert source plus deploy --metadata-dir (same content as --source-dir force-app).
Converted Leads are excluded explicitly with LEAD.CONVERTED equals 0 (Lightning shows 'Filtered by Converted').
No Data_Retention_Policy__mdt row: no new object (DM-04).

Repair 1 (validate/qa, TST-11): MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest failed in QA (0 list views) because test change 1 did not hold across classes. Reproduced in the agent scratch org with the same check-only deploy and RunSpecifiedTests set: the positive test passes alone and fails when run alongside MyOpenEnquiriesListViewDenialTest. A diagnostic class (dry-run only, never committed) showed that after the minimum-access user queries ListView with SobjectType = 'Lead', that filter returns 0 rows for every user, admin included, for the rest of the run. Filtering on DeveloperName alone stays correct: Recruitment Officer 1, Minimum Access 0, admin 1. Both tests now query on DeveloperName and keep Lead rows in Apex. The positive test also asserts SobjectType = 'Lead'. No assertion was removed or loosened. This also stops the denial test from passing vacuously. Verified with a check-only deploy of the QA test set (4/4 pass), RunLocalTests (7/7) and Playwright (5/5) in the agent scratch org.

Repair 2 (review B: PIPE-11, PIPE-09): the PR check takes only tests/e2e/specs from the PR, so the spec's import of ../support/org could not load and no Playwright test ran in tests/scratch. The helper now lives at tests/e2e/specs/support/org.ts (not *.spec.ts, so not collected; `npx playwright test --list` shows the same 5 tests). The spec imports ./support/org. The old tests/e2e/support/org.ts is now unused. The repair sandbox would not allow git rm, so a person should delete it before merge.

Repair 2 (PIPE-15, A3): afterAll now deletes the Contact and Account the conversion actually created (ConvertedContactId, ConvertedAccountId) and then the marker Leads. It uses plain delete, so any failure throws and fails the run instead of leaving data behind in QA. Checked in the agent scratch org: seed, convert, cleanup left 0 Leads, Accounts and Contacts.

Repair 2 (PIPE-11, TST-03): headers only. MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest maps AC1 only. MyOpenEnquiriesListViewDenialTest states that it proves object-level denial only, and that Playwright #20 AC3 proves the group-level share. No assertion changed.

Repair 2, not done (advisory): the denial catch was not narrowed to a specific message. The access-error text could not be checked here (the minimum-access query returned 0 rows, not an exception), and guessing it could make the test fail in QA. SF_DATA_ORG stays optional because pr-tests and deploy-qa do not set it and rely on the CLI default org; requiring it needs a .github change by a person (PIPE-08).

Repair 2 verification in the agent scratch org: deploy, personas, RunLocalTests 7/7 pass. Playwright was listed (5 tests) but not run locally, because the repair sandbox would not allow setting SF_BASE_URL. The tests/scratch check on this push is the Playwright evidence.
Repair 3 (tests/scratch harness: relative goto in global-setup, evidence body too long) no longer reproduces: tests/scratch has since passed 9/9 on this PR (run 39831013465).
Repair budget reset by a person (agent:repair-reset comment on PR #25: the pipeline moved to pool sandboxes, ADR 0003). attempts.repair counts from that reset.

Repair 1 after reset (tests/personas, run 39837639300 at 6d95b45, sandbox agent2): the Playwright seed's Database.convertLead failed with UNAVAILABLE_RECORDTYPE_EXCEPTION ('Unable to find default record type'), so #20 AC1-AC3 failed or did not run. The org copy has NPSP's Account record types (HH_Account, Organization). The new Account and Contact went to the converted Lead's owner, the Recruitment Officer persona, which has no Account record type because it cannot create Accounts (#1 AC2). Fix (setup only, TST-16): lc.setOwnerId(UserInfo.getUserId()) gives the new Account and Contact to the CLI user. The converted Lead stays the persona's, and the seed now asserts IsConverted and OwnerId == persona, so AC2's 'converted Lead is not listed' check cannot pass vacuously. No test assertion was removed or loosened, and no persona access changed. Verified in the agent sandbox: deploy succeeded; Apex 4/4 pass (LeadSourceDetailAccessTest, MyOpenEnquiriesListViewTest, MyOpenEnquiriesListViewDenialTest); the exact seed and afterAll cleanup Apex ran against the org with the persona user, and the assert held; cleanup left 0 Leads, Accounts and Contacts. Playwright could not run locally: persona login files come from scripts/personas.mjs, which the repair tool allowlist does not include. The tests/personas check on this push is the Playwright evidence.
